{{Top|leg}}
An '''Assault Wing''' was a unit of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], consisted of group of terrain vehicles, such as [[Walker/Legends|walkers]].

Assault Wings had designated home bases. [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyers]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] were large enough to serve as home bases of multiple Wings, for both assault and [[Flight group/Legends|flight]].
